name: Report / Statement
constraints: WM-REC-002 owns stable report-definition identity, immutable definition versions and immutable issued statements.
Each issue pins one definition version and state-bound evidence requirements apply before issuance.
Reporting period end, cutoff, as-of instant and issue instant are distinct and ordered.
Resolved issue bindings derive from and cannot exceed the pinned definition bindings.
Projection declarations only narrow the exact pinned WM-XCT-003 shape.
Correction or changed evidence creates a successor with predecessor, class, reason and authority.
Record artifacts have zero-to-many external identities and custody remains with WM-REC-001.
Issue, processing run, artifact, publication case and edition use disjoint identifiers.
Publication never implies issue validity and cannot cite a non-issued statement as issued.
A live dashboard is ephemeral; a snapshot without complete execution evidence remains non-citable.
BI layout, scheduling and vendor configuration never participate in report identity.
Suppression records policy provenance without exposing withheld values or small-count structure.
